Vehicle to Product Link

The Vehicle to Product Link app streamlines fleet and product management by enabling seamless integration between vehicles and associated products. Users can easily manage vehicle information, create products linked to specific vehicles, and track product movement. The app provides efficient tracking of product quantities, in-stock availability, and vehicle-related data. It simplifies the process of linking products with fleet operations, improving overall fleet management efficiency. This solution enhances data accuracy and ensures better control over inventory and vehicle management.



  • Features
  • Screenshots
  • Support
  • Service

Features

Product Creation Linked to Vehicle

Users can create a product that is directly linked to a specific vehicle. The "Create Fleet Product" form enables easy entry of product details such as product name, category, and unit of measure. This feature ensures seamless integration between fleet management and product handling, streamlining operations.

Product and Fleet Association

This functionality allows products to be associated with vehicles within the fleet. The "Fleet Information" tab in the product details shows the vehicle it is linked to, along with key vehicle data such as model and license plate. It ensures that products related to fleet operations are properly tracked and linked for efficient management.

Screenshot

1.) Vehicle Information Overview

The displayed information includes comprehensive vehicle details such as the model, license plate, and assigned driver. Important fields like the vehicle's category, order date, and registration date are also shown. Users can easily manage and update the vehicle’s details from this interface.


Navigation : Fleet → Fleet


2.) Create Fleet Product Form

This popup allows users to create a product linked directly to a vehicle. The form provides fields for entering the product name, category, type (e.g., consumable), and unit of measure. It enables seamless integration between fleet management and product creation.


Navigation : Fleet → Create Product


3.) Product Fleet Information Tab

This section provides a dedicated tab within the product details, where users can link the product to a specific vehicle. It also includes an "Is Fleet" checkbox to indicate whether the product is associated with fleet management. Additional vehicle-related data, like model and license plate, is shown for context.


Navigation : Fleet → Create Product → Product


4.) Vehicle Product Association

This interface allows the user to associate products with a vehicle. The "Product" tab displays the linked product information, and users can view relevant details such as the model and license plate. The "On Hand" and "In/Out" statistics are also provided to track product movement.


Navigation : Fleet → Fleet
